description: snirandjan/gmhcira: Global Multiple-Hazard Critical Infrastructure Risk Analysis (GMHCIRA) V1.0.0 is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors snirandjan, Elco Koks (Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam). Initial public release of the Global Multiple-Hazard Critical Infrastructure Risk Analysis (GMHCIRA). This release contains the Python implementation used to: extract critical infrastructure assets from OpenStreetMap data; calculate damages for multiple natural hazards and return periods; estimate asset-level risk; and generate exposure and risk summaries at the global and subnational levels. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
